_comment: Cover page - read first for any stock-specific task. Holds current JUDGMENT about the stock. Keep it short and qualitative; prefer a clear sentence over a half-filled structure. 'unknown' is a valid value, an invented one is not. Raw notable days go in trading_history.jsonl; numbers go in financial_valuation_snapshot.json.

market_bucket._note: Which sector/theme the market actually trades it under. Often matters more than what the company does.

why_it_moves._note: Causal drivers - policy, orders, theme, commodity. What makes this stock move at all.

real_or_proxy._options: real beneficiary | partial exposure | proxy/concept stock | unclear
real_or_proxy._note: Decides whether a theme move sustains or fades. Revenue evidence lives in financial_valuation_snapshot.json.

role_in_sector._options: leader | follower | laggard | anchor | niche | unclear
role_in_sector._note: Leaders move first and tend to hold; followers spike and fade.

how_it_trades._personality_examples: trends steadily | spikes and fades | only moves with its theme | gaps often | thin and jumpy
how_it_trades._note: Verdicts derived from trading_history.jsonl. Re-derive from the record rather than guessing. If the stock stops behaving this way, it shows up in the history first.

news_filter._note: Which information is worth reacting to. The daily noise filter.

_red_flag_examples: ST risk | 减持 | pledged shares | goodwill | 问询函 | customer concentration | cash flow far below profit

financial_digest._note: One or two lines. Open financial_valuation_snapshot.json when quality or valuation actually matters.

_refresh_note: EXCEPTIONS ONLY - triggers unique to this stock, e.g. 'reacts to 光伏 tariff news'. Standard triggers (new report, guidance, rerating, risk events) apply to every stock and live in stock_profiles_readme.md. Do not copy them here.
